rationale_one_line: v2 ships in herdr's own extracted palette (near-black, warm cream, herdr blue, JetBrains Mono like herdr.dev itself) because recognition is the quote-post trigger; RECEIPT stays, now with a drawn star-velocity curve and a count-up as the money shot.
writing_tone_notes: Plain declarative, subtraction over adjectives, matching the creator's unhyped README voice. Let the number contrast carry the praise. Exact technical claims, zero hype words. Contractions where natural.
do_rules: Lead with the count and the climb, not a feature list.
Use herdr blue as a single highlight per beat, never decoratively.
Keep the contrast doing the praise: many agents versus one terminal, one binary.
dont_rules: No version numbers in the caption.
Do not repeat any scene phrase in the tweet or the Gmail Why-this-one.
